summary: Five Below, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Third Amendment to its Credit Agreement, dated October 14, 2026, among the Company as Borrower, 1616 Holdings, Inc. as Guarantor, Wells Fargo Bank, N.A. as Agent, and the Lenders. The amendment extends the maturity date from September 16, 2027 to October 14, 2031, increases the senior secured asset-based revolving facility from $225 million to $450 million, and raises the letter of credit subline from $20 million to $50 million. This is a routine credit-facility amendment, not a special situation; no deal terms, board recommendation, or advisor are stated. Watch for any borrowing-base or covenant changes in the exhibit.
